title: Sonlar 11-20 va yosh
hook_voice: Lesson eleven. How old are you? I'm twenty.

items.uz: O'n bir, o'n ikki, o'n uch

example.en: How old are you? I'm twenty.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga o'n ikkinchi dars: bu va u.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 11-dars: inglizcha sonlar 11 dan 20 gacha va yosh.

Eleven, twelve, thirteen — O'n bir, o'n ikki, o'n uch
How old are you? — Yoshingiz nechada?
I'm twenty — Men yigirma yoshdaman

Qolgan sonlar: 14 fourteen, 15 fifteen, 16 sixteen, 17 seventeen, 18 eighteen, 19 nineteen, 20 twenty. Izohda yoshingizni inglizcha yozing!
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 12-dars: Bu va u.
